_comment: Target WhatsApp groups for the daily building-materials for-sale ad. Use group JIDs (ending in @g.us); the bot must be a MEMBER of each. Invite links are NOT reliably resolvable on this gateway (WhatsApp channels resolve is unsupported and the directory is config-backed), so always list JIDs here. Edit this list to add/remove groups; no code change needed. Names for reference: Bindura Town Business, Shamva Bindura & Madziva, Glendale Hustlers 24/7, Bindura Hustlers 24/7, ZVIRIKUITIKA MUBINDURA NEMASHONALAND CENTRAL YESE.
_weekly_comment: Groups posted to only on specific weekdays instead of daily (the cron still runs every day; these are skipped on other days). Weekdays may be names (mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun) or ints (Mon=0 .. Sun=6). MUTANDIRI VILLAGE RESIDENTS (120363166672509962@g.us) gets the building-materials ad three times a week, on Monday, Wednesday and Friday.
